'''Senior Lieutenant''' was a position in the military forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

This line rank was used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and one of the four ranks that together encompass the overall position of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. It ranked above [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]], and below [[Junior Commander/Legends|Junior Commander]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Flight Captain]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], this was the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] held by [[Brandei]] as an officer aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]], [[Kern Fallon]] of the Imperial Navy held this rank. Another Senior Lieutenant was [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] officer [[Leeds]].
